Chromium (https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src), revision 516d5cb6d930b64e2b59398f66d789c2261093e5.
Dash and dot proportions and pattern fitting in GeometryBackgroundBorder.cpp are ported from
third_party/blink/renderer/platform/graphics/styled_stroke_data.cc and third_party/blink/renderer/core/paint/box_border_painter.cc.
The Fluent scrollbar metrics in ElementScroll.cpp are ported from ui/native_theme/native_theme_fluent.h,
ui/native_theme/native_theme_fluent.cc, third_party/blink/renderer/core/scroll/scrollbar_theme_fluent.h,
third_party/blink/renderer/core/scroll/scrollbar_theme_fluent.cc and third_party/blink/renderer/core/scroll/scrollbar_theme_aura.cc.
